## Purpose

Describe the engineering problem and the scope of this change.

## Evidence class

- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Analytical
- [ ] Simulated
- [ ] Software-tested
- [ ] Physically measured

## Validation

List the exact commands, tool versions, configuration, data provenance, and results used to validate the change.

## Safety and compatibility

Describe interface changes, migration requirements, RF/safety implications, and known limitations.

## Checklist

- [ ] No confidential or unlicensed third-party material is included.
- [ ] README and validation documentation are updated.
- [ ] Generated artifacts are separated from editable sources.
- [ ] Claims do not exceed the supplied evidence.
